modelRegistryPath.description:
If provided, the service will be registered to this path. Otherwise, the service will not be created or registered.
{@see ModelRegistry#registerMlPipe}

deploySpec.description:
If provided, then this spec will be passed to {@link ModelInference#deploy}. If not provided, then the service will not be deployed.
NOTE: #modelRegistryPath must be provided if #deploySpec is provided.

route.description:
If provided, then the service will be registered to this route; otherwise, the service will not have a route registered.
{@see ModelInference#setRoute}

name: GenaiCore.DynamicPy.Service.CreateSpec
